Implement the redesigned Server Detail page as REAL code in /opt/nxeon-sandbox (an isolated sandbox clone of the Nxeon platform — do NOT touch /opt/nxeon or /opt/nxeon-staging). This app is LIVE-SERVING right now via systemd at https://flow.k9x4rq7wpz2ah6t.nxeon.cloud. Verify your work with `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` only — do NOT run `npm run build` and do NOT restart/touch systemd services (a coordinated final build+restart happens later, after all parallel redesign work lands).

## What already exists (foundation + parallel work — read, don't recreate)
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/primitives.tsx` — `Surface` (`elevated?: boolean`), `IconTile` (`tone?: "violet"|"cyan"|"green"|"blue"`), `Pill`/`StatusPill` (`tone?: "brand"|"good"|"warn"|"bad"|"neutral"`), `StatCardV2`, `Gauge`, `BarMeter` (good for CPU/RAM/disk usage bars).
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/icons.tsx` — new hand-drawn 24×24 icons including `IconMonitor`, `IconLock`, `IconTerminal`, `IconRefresh`, `IconShield`, `IconShieldCheck`, `IconAlert`, `IconGear` etc. — check the full exported list before drawing anything new; only add to this same file (matching its convention) if genuinely nothing fits, pulling shapes from the mockup below.
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/app/globals.css` — tokens `--color-pv-*` (→ `bg-pv-*`/`text-pv-*`/`border-pv-*`, incl. `-good`/`-warn`/`-bad` semantic states), `--radius-pv-*`, `--font-pv-display`/`--font-pv-body`, `.pv-surface`/`.pv-surface-elevated` classes.
- Other agents are concurrently touching `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`/`components/portal-v2/DashboardShellV2.tsx` (nav/shell), `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx` (VPS wizard), and `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx` (billing) — do not touch those files.

## Read before writing any code
1. `/tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/portal-redesign-server.html` — the approved mockup: persistent status header (identity + live-state + primary actions) always visible above the tabs, alerts surfaced above routine tabs, tab content regrouped by task (Access / Performance / Data protection / Danger zone) instead of 1:1 with current component names.
2. The FULL current `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` — this file branches heavily on `isGameServer` (a Server whose `osTemplate.family` is in `GAME_FAMILIES` from `lib/games.ts`) and renders a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT, already-fairly-good panel for game servers (`components/customer/gamepanel/GameServerPanel.tsx` + `GamePanelHeader.tsx`) vs. plain VPS servers (`ServerTabs`-style tabs). Read enough to understand this branch clearly.
3. **Scope decision: focus on the PLAIN VPS branch (non-game-server) for this task.** The game-server panel is a separate, larger piece of work (13 flat tabs → regrouped) that's out of scope here — leave `GameServerPanel.tsx`/`GamePanelHeader.tsx` completely untouched. Your job is the plain-VPS server detail experience: persistent status header + task-grouped tabs (Access / Performance / Data protection / Danger zone, or close to it — use your judgment matching the mockup, but the "Danger zone" tab for destructive actions like reinstall/delete is a firm requirement, matching the mockup's explicit design intent to separate routine actions from irreversible ones).

## What to build
- A persistent status header component (server name/hostname, `StatusPill` for RUNNING/PENDING/ERROR/SUSPENDED, IP address, plan name, primary actions — start/stop/reboot/console — ALWAYS visible, not just inside one tab) — reuse across whatever the current page renders for plain VPS servers.
- An alert rail above the tabs for real problem states already computed in the current code (e.g. `ResourceLimitAlert` if it exists for VPS, any FAILED/provisionError banner, suspend/dunning banners) — promote these above the tab content so they're visible regardless of which tab is active, matching the pattern already used correctly elsewhere in this codebase.
- Regroup the current tabs by task instead of 1:1-with-component-name. Read what tabs currently exist for a plain VPS server (Overview/Console/Files/Backups/Networking/Settings or similar — check the actual file) and consolidate into something close to: **Overview**, **Access** (SSH/console/credentials), **Performance** (resource metrics — use `Gauge`/`BarMeter`/existing `Sparkline` from `components/ui/charts.tsx`), **Data protection** (backups/volumes), **Settings**, **Danger zone** (reinstall/delete/suspend-adjacent destructive actions). Adjust the exact grouping to match what real tabs actually exist — don't invent tabs for functionality that doesn't exist.

## Constraints
- Do not change any real server-control action (start/stop/reboot/reinstall/delete), any real data query, or any real resource-limit threshold — this is a structural reorganization + visual restyle only.
- The sandbox has a real running demo VPS (hostname `demo-vps`, status RUNNING, fake IP) — verify your new page actually renders correctly against this real server row, not just against empty/mock state.
- Do NOT touch the game-server branch/panel at all.
- No new external dependencies.

## When done
Report: exact files created/modified, confirmation `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes cleanly, and a plain list of every real tab/section from the OLD plain-VPS server page and which new tab it now lives in — so a reviewer can confirm nothing real was silently dropped.
